name: load

test_list.description: Defaults < Global < Repo < Env < Session; the highest layer setting a key wins, regardless of input order.
Nested tables merge key by key; scalars and arrays are replaced whole.
Provenance names the layer (and file) that set each key; untouched keys report Defaults.
A key outside the schema is UnknownKey with its dotted path.
A known key with the wrong type or range is Invalid with the key.
With no layers but defaults, load succeeds with the documented defaults.
proptest: merging a layer with an identical layer changes nothing.
budget.usd keeps its exact decimal text; an integer (e.g. from POLARIS_BUDGET__USD=5) is accepted; a TOML float is rejected (no binary rounding).
For random per-layer assignments, each key takes the value of the highest layer that set it (else the default) and provenance names exactly that layer.

output_description: Typed config plus per-key provenance; pure (no I/O).
